manufacturer_source.name: ASUS Australia official support
manufacturer_source.finding: ASUS Australia's model correspondence table lists Zenfone 12 Ultra with model no. AI2501H and model name AI2501, while ROG Phone 9 and ROG Phone 9 Pro use model no. AI2501 and model name AI2501.

safety_notes: ROG Phone 9 and ROG Phone 9 Pro legitimately share model number AI2501 and must not be deduplicated solely on that value.
Zenfone 12 Ultra uses ASUS model name AI2501 but ASUS model no. AI2501H; the catalogue model_number field should not silently conflate those concepts.
No live catalogue row is changed by this evidence package.
Any future model-number correction requires explicit human authorization plus an immediate active-status, dependency, collision, and identity recheck.
Abort if the catalogue's model_number semantic is shown to intentionally store ASUS model name rather than ASUS model no.
